annotations.title: Italian Corporate Labor Cost Calculator (Costo Azienda)

description:
[Deterministic Italian payroll calculation. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates the full employer-side total labor cost (Costo Aziendale): Gross Annual Salary (RAL), employer INPS social security contributions (~24%), INAIL occupational accident insurance premium, annual TFR severance accrual (Art. 2120 Codice Civile), and real net hourly employment cost across 13 or 14 months.
Usage: Use this tool to evaluate total corporate cost for hiring or retaining an employee in Italy. Do NOT use for employee take-home net pay simulation (use 'lordo_netto_irpef_simulator' instead).
Returns: JSON object with { ralEur: number, inpsEmployerEur: number, inailPremiumEur: number, tfrAccrualEur: number, totalCompanyCostEur: number, monthlyCostEur: number, hourlyCostEur: number, assumptions: object }.

applyYouthIncentiveUnder36.description: Whether statutory youth/women hiring incentive exemption applies

atecoSector.description: Italian ATECO macro-industry sector for INPS/INAIL rates

inailRatePerThousand.description: INAIL occupational safety rate per thousand (e.g. 4.0 for commerce, 12.0 for manufacturing)

monthsCount.description: Number of salary months (13 for 13th month bonus, 14 for 13th+14th)
